results.content: # Big Five Personality Test. This free personality test gives you accurate scores for the Big Five personality traits. The Big Five describes personality traits along five common dimensions: Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness and Neuroticism. ## What is the Big Five Personality Test? When you take a Big Five test, you will receive scores for five dimensions of personality:. This makes the Big Five model distinct from many pop psychology systems that classify people in terms of personality "types." In a Big Five test, rather than being sorted into types, people are described in terms of how they compare with the average across each of the five personality traits. ## Big Five Personality Test FAQ. What is the Big Five personality test based on? **A.** The Big Five personality test is a comprehensive personality inventory based on decades of psychological research. results.title: Towards a Taxonomy of Personality Descriptors | Springer Nature Link
results.content: Personality psychology has not yet established a generally accepted, systematic framework for distinguishing, ordering, and naming individual differences in people’s behavior and experience. Such a systematic framework is generally called a taxonomy.
